status: retained; modest end-to-end gain, prose flat; upstream FP4 headline goal remains open
change: Dispatch selected remaining mixed-format projections to the existing exact W16/R4/T1/Min4/Narrow kernel. Share activation staging across four output rows; preserve each output arithmetic and accumulation order. One launcher change, no numerical kernel body, weight, allocation, model option, test or tool added.
selection_limits: These constant shapes bound all 32-bit offsets. Smaller Q6 batches, IQ4_NL down widths3/4, IQ3_S width4 and Q3_K were slower and retain their original dispatch. Narrow indexing alone is not generally faster. Scalar/B2 and already tuned Q6/IQ4XS FFNs stay unchanged.

speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, 32-token raw JSON warmup per binary excluded. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

prose_confirmation.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two new timed samples per binary in BAAB order; prose-only confirmation of ambiguous initial row, 32-token raw JSON warmup per binary excluded. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

pooled_prose.method: All four samples per binary, initial ABBA plus prose-only BAAB confirmation; no sample excluded. Two warmup runs before each series excluded.

quality.scope: Both existing quantized operator suites; both Q4/Q8 target full-vocabulary/features/retained-feature/C3 mixed-cache/logical262144 short-prefix suites;90 Q4 draft trace files against contiguous-FFN qualified baseline. All16 measured continuations match qualified AR hashes with identical acceptance/round counts. Sampler/draft arithmetic unchanged; broad sampling/HTTP/Q8BF16 draft trace/depth/capability suites not repeated. No new maintained tests.
